notes.title: New BRUTAL Berserker-Mode and Fatality style Finishers💀
notes.content:
Hey all, I've just finalized a brutal new combat system: the Berserker-Mode! It's a gratuitous combat window where you can brutalize enemies with your bare hands. You can enter this mode by drinking mead or during particularly bloody combat encounters, turning you into an unhinged murderous psychopath. It's pretty fun!! 

[b]Watch the video devlog showcasing this feature below. I hope you like it![/b]
